description: A vintage-style television with a gray, boxy screen and two antennas protruding from the top. It features two circular, light green knobs on the right side. The television is supported by a transparent, pedestal-like base with a reflective, metallic finish. The overall aesthetic suggests an older era of electronic devices, possibly from the mid-20th century. The screen appears to have a slightly glossy or reflective surface, hinting at a cathode-ray tube design. The antennas are thin and angled upwards, typical of early broadcast reception. The stand is rounded and wide at the base, adding a sense of stability to the somewhat retro design.
